description: Google Play's testing tracks as Play has them: internal testing, closed testing (alpha and any closed track of the app's own naming) and open testing, each with the release on it now (name, version codes, status) and, for internal and closed tracks, its tester Google Groups. Play's API knows testers only as Google Groups: Play Console's email lists (the only kind internal testing takes there) aren't in it, and open testing has no list. Also the opt-in link testers join through and the app's Play Console IDs. testersError says why the groups couldn't be read (Play's daily edit limit for the app, mostly). Kept for 10 minutes; fresh asks Play again, which may use one of the app's daily edits.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

track.description: Only this track, like internal or alpha.

name: ploa_play_testers_get
title: Read Google Play testers
